{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping missing values
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the exact mean values for each species
print('Mean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Identify and print the species with the highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
